services.name: Agent Platform

threatContext.prompt-injection: Indirect injection through managed MCP server responses poisoning agent context, multi-agent orchestration chains amplifying injection across coordinated agents, grounding data from enterprise sources manipulating agent behavior

threatContext.tool-invocation-abuse: Managed MCP servers with broad GCP API access exploited through crafted agent context, multi-agent coordination enabling cascading unauthorized tool calls across agent boundaries
threatContext.sensitive-data-exposure: Agent memory persisting sensitive conversation data across sessions, managed MCP server responses caching confidential enterprise data, agent orchestration logs in Cloud Logging capturing PII from tool interactions
threatContext.misconfiguration: Agent identity policies left at defaults allowing unrestricted tool access, managed MCP servers deployed with excessive data source connectivity, agent memory retention configured without expiration policies
threatContext.excessive-permissions: Agent service accounts with broad roles (roles/aiplatform.admin) instead of scoped agent-specific roles, managed MCP server connections configured with project-level access to all data sources

threatContext.data-exfiltration: Agent tool connectors orchestrating multi-step data extraction across Cloud Storage, BigQuery, and other GCP data sources in a single session, agent orchestration logs aggregating sensitive data from multiple enterprise systems
threatContext.third-party-integration-risk: Managed MCP server connections to third-party services introducing trust dependencies on external tool providers, agent workflows routing enterprise data through external endpoints without visibility into third-party security posture
threatContext.credential-theft: Agent runtime service account tokens exposed via GCP metadata server (http://metadata.google.internal), managed MCP server credentials stored in agent configurations, API keys for connected services accessible through agent environment variables
threatContext.dos-attack: Prompt-induced agent loops repeatedly invoking models and tools, recursive multi-agent calls exhausting generative AI quota, long-running sessions driving pay-per-use cost
